4-bit optimizer-state quantization error perturbs AdamW updates through moment recurrences | ZIP-SR preconditioner-space stochastic rounding + ZE-EDEN zero-excluding calibration; cuts TorchAO 4-bit validation-loss gap to 32-bit by up to 70% across 130M-2.7B pretraining

deception and sabotage are often unverbalized and invisible to action-only text monitors | multi-layer/token probe architecture trained on the largest deception dataset; 98.4%/98.0% AUROC on SHADE-/BASH-Arena vs 97.9%/97.6% text monitors, up to 99.7% AUROC separating true hidden goals

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: assumed evaluation boundaries failed in OpenAI, Anthropic and Google agent security incidents | comparative case study deriving PASAC and a five-layer boundary assurance stack; 9 design propositions and 7 falsifiable hypotheses; qualitative, no quantitative evaluation

METR time-horizon estimates assume AI difficulty is linear in log human time | spline/IRT recomputation on 228 tasks and 26 AIs; flat 2-30min region, proper-scoring-rule validation | capability-metric statistics; not loop reward design and not a system card

image editors need human-edited pairs or external reward models to improve | Rubric-CEPR rubric-augmented contrastive edit-preservation critic + verified self-distillation; ImgEdit 4.36 to 4.60, +24.9% object isolation | single-domain image-editing self-training; not an agent or research-loop self-improvement system

composing many circuits by naive union fails | CircuitTree density-scaled greedy composition with Theta(N log N) tree-compose schedule; 39 HuBERT phoneme circuits compose into a syllable classifier at 64.8% vs 66.0% ceiling with 99.5% of components shared

LLM program search needs to exploit accumulated high scorers | EliteTable fixed-capacity elite table guiding proposals/edits/remixes; candidate-score medians rise in all 6 Gymnasium tasks, held-out gains in 4/6; no baselines named, comparisons and ablations pending

MCTS for DAG workflow scheduling is rarely given an equal-budget control | preregistered equal-budget protocol; MCTS 2.88% worse than randomized restarts at 2048 evaluated schedules (95% CI), 700/720 first results are the warm start; synthetic domain up to 32 tasks

zeroth-order fine-tuning samples training examples uniformly | SAZO learns sample importance online from gradient-norm proxies; up to 6x faster convergence, O(N) extra state | gradient-free optimization efficiency; not RL post-training dynamics or failures

static coding benchmarks leak into training data and saturate | SWE-Duel mirrored Red-Blue arena creating tasks and oracles at evaluation time; 11 model-harness participants, 1,500 turns over 15 repos; newest-version-authored tasks defeat a fixed solver 42.9% vs 4.0%

parallel speculative draft blocks lose intra-block dependencies | DCOCO parallel contextual scoring of retained candidates; highest throughput in every configuration, up to 6.6x speedup | pure serving speed; no precision or reliability angle

forward-process RL of diffusion models is unstable without tuned EMA off-policy training, and joint positive-negative training cancels a hidden forward-reverse consistency force only partially | DiffusionART aggregation-first reward tilting + trust-region-masked restoration without EMA tuning; matches DiffusionNFT/Flow-GRPO-Fast late-stage rewards with ~12x fewer GPU hours on HunyuanVideo-13B

observed learner weaknesses do not specify how synthesis should change (feedback-to-decision gap) | EvoSyn revisable generation-space state with role-specialized agents; +13.3 points on tau2-Bench/CAR-Bench over the strongest synthesis baseline

long-horizon strategic play is under-measured | SpireBench full Slay the Spire at maximum difficulty, 20 LLMs; frontier matches average human, far behind experts, misjudges run-level risk | pure agent benchmark, excluded for Self-Evolving

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: binary verifiable rewards cannot distinguish debugging quality among same-outcome SWE trajectories | BSR policy-judged pairwise preferences converted to bounded auxiliary rewards preserving pass/fail ordering; consistent gains on SWE-bench Verified/Live with Qwen3-14B/32B
